title: A Computational Analysis of the Dehumanisation of Migrants from Syria and Ukraine in Slovene News Media
findings: The study found that the concept of 'migrant' became semantically closer to 'moral disgust' (a concept defined partly by terms of religious transgression) in the 2022-23 period (Ukraine crisis) compared to the 2015-16 period (Syria crisis). However, within the 2022-23 period, news articles communicated less moral disgust when addressing Ukrainian migrants compared to migrants of other nationalities.

measurement_description: The paper measures dehumanization, specifically the association of migrants with concepts of 'moral disgust'. This concept is defined by a list of Slovene words, several of which have religious or moral-religious connotations, such as 'sinner', 'desecration', 'godless', and 'blasphemous'. The benchmark thus measures the semantic closeness of 'migrant' to terms of moral and religious transgression.
